title: AP balance by vendor at each month end with debit balances and duplicate vendor names
prompt: Show the AP balance by vendor at each month end this year. Flag vendors with debit balances and vendor records that look like the same vendor under two names.
steps: pull the AP aging as of each month end this year
build the vendor by month table and tie each month's total to the balance sheet AP line
run name_similarity over the vendor list for near-duplicate names

done.text: The vendor table total at the latest month end equals accounts payable on Dime's balance sheet
Every exception row cites the vendor id
ap-by-vendor.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every debit balance says which payment was likely applied to the wrong vendor; near-duplicate names are listed as pairs with the evidence
